title: How access pathways change in the model

scenes.title: Telehealth joins the access pathway
scenes.narration: The 2026 snapshot adds a modeled link from Telehealth Treatment to Treatment Access. That connection is not included in the 2010 snapshot.

fact.title: A new connection: Telehealth Treatment
fact.claim: The later snapshot includes Telehealth Treatment → Treatment Access (sign +, modeled strength 0.70); this edge is absent from the earlier snapshot. Absence does not establish that the relationship did not exist in reality.

scenes.title: Behavioral therapy moves behind an access step
scenes.narration: The 2010 snapshot directly links Diagnosis Status to Behavioral Therapy. In 2026, the graph instead represents Diagnosis Status → Treatment Access → Behavioral Therapy; this structural comparison does not establish causal equivalence.

fact.title: A different route to Behavioral Therapy
fact.claim: The earlier snapshot directly links Diagnosis Status to Behavioral Therapy. That direct edge is absent in the later snapshot, which contains the path Diagnosis Status → Treatment Access → Behavioral Therapy. This is a structural comparison, not proof that the path is causally equivalent.
